verdict.rationale: Twenty's docs say users can connect a Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 mailbox, after which emails are automatically linked to the matching Company and People records, with filters by date range or sender. That covers connecting and auto-logging, but the evidence only shows inbound import, not two-way sync (e.g., sending or replying from the CRM syncing back to the mailbox). Missing for 10: documented two-way sync, explicit support for consumer Gmail/Outlook.com accounts, independent or hands-on corroboration of matching accuracy.
